title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development environment setup
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud-specific development instructions to help future agents quickly set up and work in this codebase. ### What's included - **Project overview**: Next.js 14 event ticketing platform with Supabase backend - **Dev server commands**: `npm run dev`, `npm run dev:turbo`, `npm run dev:fresh` - **Lint/build/check commands**: `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npm run check` - **Environment variable guidance**: How to set up `.env.local` from `.env.example` - **Key gotchas**: No test suite, external Supabase dependency, i18n routing, admin panel path, ESLint config notes, auth page behavior, i18n check script ### Development environment verification | Check | Status | |-------|--------| | `npm install` | ✅ 815 packages installed | | `npm run lint` | ✅ Passes (warnings only) | | `npm run build` | ✅ 66 pages generated | | `npm run dev` | ✅ Serves on localhost:3000 | | `node scripts/check-i18n-keys.js` | ✅ All 743 keys match across 3 locales | ### Hello world demo Verified core app functionality: - Homepage renders in Turkish (`/tr`) and German (`/de`) with full locale switching - Login form (`/tr/giris`) accepts input and submits (returns expected error with placeholder credentials) - Admin panel (`/yonetim`) redirects to login when unauthenticated [hello_world_demo.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-75ca494b-4cb9-4647-9882-201a4ffa238a/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fhello_world_demo.mp4) [Turkish homepage](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-75ca494b-4cb9-4647-9882-201a4ffa238a/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fhello_homepage_tr.webp) [German locale](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-75ca494b-4cb9-4647-9882-201a4ffa238a/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fhello_locale_de.webp) [Login form submission](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-75ca494b-4cb9-4647-9882-201a4ffa238a/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fhello_login_submit.webp) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
